name: HEIC for Jelly
description: Makes HEIC/HEIF photos visible and renderable in a Jellyfin photo library.
overview: Adds HEIC support to photo libraries.
changelog: First working release. HEIC/HEIF photos resolve into Photo items, decode through the server's own ffmpeg (tile grids included, with the container's irot rotation applied), and carry their EXIF date, camera and GPS. Requires ffmpeg 7.0 or newer.
